# Mary & Lydia's Story: 40+ Years of Survival Against All Odds **⚠️ URGENT: This is not just a story of disability. This is a story of survival.** Mary has lived with her disability for **40+ years**. Lydia for **20+ years**. But their greatest threats are not their disabilities—it's the land-grabbing authorities, suspected poisonings, untreated medical emergencies, and a community that wants them gone. **They need permanent safe housing and urgent medical evacuation NOW.** ## 💪 Born Able-Bodied: Disabilities That Appeared Without Explanation **Both Mary and Lydia were born NORMAL—fully able-bodied with no disabilities.** Their disabilities developed mysteriously over time, transforming in "unexplainable ways" that doctors could not diagnose or reverse. What started as minor symptoms gradually escalated into permanent, life-altering mobility impairments. - **Mary:** Disability onset 40+ years ago (cause unknown, irreversible) - **Lydia:** Disability onset 20+ years ago (progressive deterioration, unexplained) **Neither was born disabled. Life took that from them without warning and without cure.** Despite decades of struggle, they have maintained hope and dignity—but now face threats far worse than their disabilities: **persecution, poisoning, and medical neglect**. --- ## 👩 Mary's Journey: 40+ Years of Disability + Recent Family Poisonings Mary has lived with her disability for **over 40 years**. But in 2019, her life became a nightmare. ### ☠️ The 2019 Family Tragedy: Poisoning by In-Law Relative **In 2019, Mary lost BOTH her mother and her sister within a 2-week span after they were poisoned at home.** **What happened:** - 🥤 **Mary's mother and sister drank water together at their home** - 👥 **The water was served by a "close" in-law relative** - ☠️ **Within hours, both became violently ill** ("hell broke loose") - 🏥 **Rushed to hospital, but could not be saved** - 💔 **Both health deteriorated rapidly** - ⚰️ **Both died in the same hospital, 2 weeks apart** - 😢 **Mary herself was a patient-looker at the hospital** - despite her own disability, she stayed by their bedsides with other supporting siblings, watching them die **The suspected perpetrators and their motives:** - 👥 **Close in-law relative** who served the poisoned water - 🏘️ **Jealous family members** seeking to grab the land - 🏘️ **Outsiders with land disputes** - neighbors coveting their property - ⛪ **The neighboring church** - wants their land to build a house for their priest - 👮 **The area chief** - complicit in the land-grabbing schemes **The motive?** Senseless jealousy toward a family that has "nothing to envy"—two disabled women with no income, living in poverty, yet targeted for a small plot of land. **Mary's words:** *"If my able-bodied mother and sister could be poisoned and killed, what protection do Lydia and I have as disabled, vulnerable women? She knows Lydia and her could be next."* ### 📅 Mary's Current Crisis (2024-2025) - ♿ **40+ years of disability** with limited access to proper care - 💔 **5+ years of trauma** from family poisonings (mother + sister, 2019) - 🏚️ **EVICTION THREAT** - local church and chief want their ancestral land - 🩸 **Diabetes worsening** due to chronic stress from threats - 💔 **High blood pressure** requiring emergency hospital visits - 😰 **Living in constant fear** - "We could be poisoned next" - 💸 **Zero income** - cannot afford to relocate to safety - 🙍‍♀️ **Social isolation** - community complicit in persecution ### 🆘 What Mary URGENTLY Needs: 1. **Permanent safe housing AWAY from current location** (land purchase + construction) 2. Ongoing medical care for diabetes and blood pressure 3. Legal protection from land-grabbing authorities 4. Psychological support for trauma from family deaths **Shame on the church. Shame on the area chief. Disabled women are being persecuted for land.** --- ## 👩‍🦽 Lydia's Crisis: 20+ Years of Disability + 10+ Years of Untreated Rotting Leg Wounds Lydia has lived with her disability for **over 20 years**. But her condition is deteriorating rapidly due to **complete medical neglect**. ### 🩹 The Untreated Wound Crisis (10+ YEARS) **Lydia has open leg wounds that have gone untreated for MORE THAN 10 YEARS.** **Current reality:** - 🦟 **Wounds infested with insects** - she uses pieces of cloth to keep flies away - 🤢 **Stench from rotting flesh** - wounds are festering and infected - 🩹 **NO proper medical dressing** - only torn cloth strips - 🙏 **Last professional wound care: 2023** - one-time treatment from a kind well-wisher who took her to have wounds medically cleaned and dressed - 💔 **Since 2023:** No follow-up care, wounds have deteriorated back to crisis levels - ⚠️ **Risk of sepsis, gangrene, amputation** - without urgent intervention, she will lose her legs or die - 😢 **Constant pain** - sleeps with wounds exposed, cannot afford bandages **She urgently needs MEDICAL EVACUATION to specialized facilities outside Kenya for:** 1. **Wound debridement** (surgical cleaning of dead tissue) 2. **Antibiotic treatment** (intravenous, hospital-grade) 3. **Skin grafts** if tissue is too damaged 4. **Long-term wound care** with proper dressings **Without urgent airlifting to better medical facilities abroad, Lydia will die from infection.** ### 🦴 Jaw Bone Deterioration - Losing Ability to Speak and Eat **Lydia's jaw bones are CLOSING**, making her unable to: - 🗣️ **Speak clearly** - talking is becoming increasingly difficult - 🍽️ **Eat solid food** - can only consume soft/liquid meals - 😔 **Communicate her pain** - progressively losing her voice **She needs:** - 🏥 **Maxillofacial surgery** (jaw reconstruction) - 🦴 **Bone grafts or implants** to prevent complete jaw closure - 🩺 **Specialized dental/surgical care** (unavailable in rural Kenya) ### 📉 Lydia's Full Crisis List - ♿ **20+ years of disability** (unexplained onset, irreversible) - 🩹 **10+ years of untreated leg wounds** (rotting, fly-infested, stinking) - 🦴 **Jaw bones closing** (cannot speak or eat properly) - 🏚️ **Eviction threat** (same land-grabbing persecution as Mary) - 💸 **Zero income** - completely dependent on charity - 🚫 **No access to hospitals** - rural clinic cannot treat her conditions - 😰 **Living in constant pain and humiliation** ### 🆘 What Lydia URGENTLY Needs: 1. **MEDICAL EVACUATION to advanced hospital outside Kenya** (India, South Africa, or Europe) 2. **Wound treatment surgery** - debridement, antibiotics, skin grafts 3. **Jaw reconstruction surgery** - before she loses ability to speak/eat entirely 4. **Permanent safe housing** (same as Mary - away from persecutors) 5. **Long-term nursing care** for wound management **Lydia has suffered for 10+ years with rotting legs wrapped in dirty cloth. This is a humanitarian crisis.** ### 📹 Video Testimonials Mary and Lydia have shared their stories and demonstrated their challenges in video testimonials. Watch their testimonials below to understand the severity of their situation. **These are not exaggerations. These are documented medical emergencies being ignored.** #### Lydia's Story

Both died within 2 weeks in the same hospital. Mary, despite her disability, stayed by their bedsides as a patient-looker, watching them die. **The perpetrators were motivated by land greed—targeting a family with "nothing to envy" except a small plot of land.** ### ⚠️ Cascading Crises Since 2019 - ☠️ **2019:** Mother and sister poisoned and killed by in-law relative - 💸 **2019:** Lost both caregivers and all financial support - 😢 **2019:** Mary witnessed their deaths as hospital patient-looker despite her disability - 🩹 **2019-2023:** Lydia's leg wounds untreated for 10+ years (festering, rotting, fly-infested) - 🙏 **2023:** One-time wound care from kind stranger (temporary relief for Lydia) - 🏚️ **2024:** Eviction threats escalate (church, chief, jealous relatives pressure intensifies) - 🩸 **2024:** Mary's diabetes and blood pressure worsen from chronic trauma - 🩹 **2024-2025:** Lydia's wounds deteriorate back to crisis levels (rotting flesh, stench) - 🦴 **2024-2025:** Lydia's jaw bones closing (losing ability to speak and eat) - 😰 **Now (2025):** Living in constant fear - "Lydia and her could be next" --- ## 🧱 Daily Challenges They Face Their journey illustrates the systemic barriers faced by disabled individuals in Kenya: ### 🏥 Healthcare Access - 🚑 **Limited availability** of specialized medical services - 💊 **High costs** of medications and treatments - 🚌 **Transportation barriers** to clinics and hospitals - ♿ **Lack of assistive devices** like wheelchairs and mobility aids ### 🏗️ Infrastructure Barriers - 🛗 Most buildings lack wheelchair ramps - 🚌 Public transportation is inaccessible - 🛣️ Roads and pathways are poorly maintained - 🚻 Sanitation facilities are not adapted ### 💸 Economic Challenges - 📉 **High unemployment** among disabled individuals (80%+ in Kenya) - 🚫 **Discrimination** in hiring practices - 🛠️ **Limited vocational training** opportunities - 🏛️ **Inadequate government support** programs ### 🧠 Social Stigma - ❌ Misconceptions about disability - 🚪 Social exclusion from community activities - 🗳️ Limited representation in decision-making - 😔 Psychological impact of discrimination --- ## 📊 Disability in Kenya: The Bigger Picture Mary and Lydia's story reflects a larger crisis: - 👥 **3+ million** Kenyans live with disabilities - ♿ **60%** lack access to assistive devices - 📉 **80%+** unemployment rate among disabled adults - 🏛️ **Limited government funding** for disability services - 🏥 **Inadequate healthcare** infrastructure --- ## 💝 How Your Donation Makes a Difference Every contribution directly improves Mary and Lydia's quality of life: ### 💵 $25 Donation Provides - 🏞️ **Purchase land** in a safe location away from persecutors - 🏗️ **Build accessible home** (wheelchair ramps, wide doors, accessible bathroom) - 🚰 **Install water and sanitation** facilities - 🔐 **Security fencing** to protect from threats - 📍 **Proximity to hospital** for ongoing medical care **Without permanent housing, Mary and Lydia remain targets for the next poisoning.** --- ## 🚨 URGENT PRIORITIES (What They Need MOST) ### 1. **Permanent Safe Housing ($15,000-25,000)** Mary and Lydia CANNOT stay on their current land. They will be killed. They need: - Land purchase in a different, safer region of Kenya - Accessible home construction (ramps, wide doorways) - Water, electricity, sanitation - Security fencing - Legal land title to prevent future land-grabbing ### 2. **Lydia's Medical Evacuation ($5,000-15,000)** Lydia's 10+ year untreated wounds require URGENT specialized care unavailable in rural Kenya: - Airlifting to India, South Africa, or Dubai for surgery - Wound debridement (surgical removal of dead tissue) - Antibiotic treatment (IV, hospital-grade) - Skin grafts if needed - Jaw reconstruction surgery before complete closure ### 3. **Mary's Ongoing Diabetes & Blood Pressure Care ($200/month)** - Monthly medications - Regular hospital visits - Blood sugar monitoring supplies - Psychological counseling for trauma ### 4. **Legal Protection & Justice ($1,000-3,000)** - Lawyer fees to fight land-grabbing attempts - Police reports documenting threats - Restraining orders against persecutors - Investigation into 2019 poisoning deaths **Total Urgent Need: $25,000-50,000 to save their lives** --- ## 🌟 Their Hope for the Future: Safety, Healing, and Dignity Despite 40+ years of disability, poisoning deaths, untreated wounds, and constant threats, Mary and Lydia maintain hope for: ### 1. **SAFETY: Permanent Housing Away from Persecutors** - 🏡 **A safe home** where they won't fear being poisoned next - 🔐 **Security** from land-grabbing relatives, church, and chief - 🛏️ **Accessible living** with ramps, wide doors, accessible bathroom - 🚰 **Clean water** they can trust (not served by in-law relatives) - 📍 **Proximity to hospital** for emergency medical care ### 2. **HEALING: Lydia's Medical Evacuation & Surgery** - ✈️ **Airlifting to advanced hospital** outside Kenya - 🩹 **Wound treatment** to stop 10+ years of rotting flesh - 🦴 **Jaw reconstruction** before she loses ability to speak/eat entirely - 💊 **Antibiotics** to prevent sepsis and gangrene - 🏥 **Long-term nursing care** for proper wound management ### 3. **STABILITY: Mary's Diabetes & Trauma Care** - 🩸 **Diabetes management** with regular medications - 💔 **Psychological support** for witnessing mother/sister poisoning deaths - 🏥 **Blood pressure monitoring** (worsened by 5+ years of threats) - 🧘 **Peace of mind** from living in a safe home ### 4. **JUSTICE: Legal Protection & Investigation** - ⚖️ **Investigation** into 2019 poisoning deaths (mother + sister) - 👮 **Police protection** from land-grabbing threats - 📜 **Legal land title** in their names (new safe location) - 🚫 **Restraining orders** against persecutors ### 5. **DIGNITY: A Life Worth Living** - 🤝 **Social inclusion** in a new community that welcomes them - 💼 **Economic opportunities** (small business, agritech entrepreneurship) - 👥 **Human connection** without fear of betrayal - 🌅 **Hope for tomorrow** instead of fear of poisoning today --- ## 📸 Following Their Journey When you donate to AbleHearts, you become part of Mary and Lydia's journey toward independence and dignity.
